title: Commands: show and list with --json
lead:
`dlog show ID` and `dlog list [--status S] [--tag T] [--key K]`, each with
`--json`.
findings_note: PROJECT.md v1 feature tier; Milestone 2; acceptance (--json)
boundary: **Not in this slice:** inbox, check and context.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Agents and the owner need to read records; every read command needs `--json`
with a stable shape (acceptance criteria).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: The `query` and `render` modules from the Architecture sketch, and CLI tests.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `show` prints all fields and the history; `show --json` gives the record.
- `list` filters by status, tag and key, singly and combined.
- The `--json` output for both commands is stable across runs (determinism).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Implement filtering in `query` and text/JSON output in `render`. Document the
JSON shape of both commands where the project keeps its docs.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- The project test command passes.
- `slicer check --json` is clean.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body:
Worktree under `.worktrees/` on a feature branch. No commit unless the owner
asks; no AI attribution.
